results.title: VERTICUS series (Helium) · Air-cooled compressors | BAUER KO
results.content:
Document: VERTICUS series (Helium) · Air-cooled compressors | BAUER KO
CUS is an air-cooled high-pressure compressor for industrial applications and is specifically designed for the compression of helium and other noble gases.
What
performance range does the VERTICUS cover for helium?
The VERTICUS is an air-cooled high-pressure compressor for industrial applications and is specifically designed for the compression of helium and other noble gases.This BAUER G series offers delivery rates from 240 to 420 l/min and operating pressures of up to 350 bar, depending on the model and process gas.
How is the VERTICUS controlled and monitored?
The compressor is equipped with the B-CONTROL MICRO control system. It enables easy operation, safe monitoring of operating parameters, and connectivity to the B-CLOUD and B-APP.
What
are the benefits of B-CLOUD?
B-CLOUD enables centralized digital monitoring of the compressor. Operators have continuous access to operating data, can monitor system status, and plan maintenance more efficiently.
Which
gases is the VERTICUS suitable for?
The G series is designed for the compression of helium as well as other noble gases. The configuration is optimized for high gas tightness and efficient handling of these gases.
How
maintenance-friendly is the VERTICUS?
section: VERTICUS series (Helium) · Air-cooled compressors / BAUER KO

results.title: B 26 series · Water-Cooled Compressors | BAUER KOMPRESSOREN
results.content:
Document: B 26 series · Water-Cooled Compressors | BAUER KOMPRESSOREN
itoring
The intake filter is equipped with a vacuum monitoring system, which is continuously monitored by the B-CONTROL compressor control unit.
B-CLOUD & B-APP
With BAUER B-CLOUD and the B-APP, users can keep an eye on their compressor system at all times, even remotely. Operating data, maintenance instructions, and status messages are transmitted and visualized in real time. This increases transparency, simplifies monitoring, and supports optimized maintenance planning. In addition, the stored operating data in the B-CLOUD is available for later analysis and system performance optimization. If the condition of your compressor system changes, B-CLOUD or B-APP will notify you immediately – by email or via push notification straight to your smartphone.
B-LINK
Wi-Fi and 4G routers enable the wireless communication of the B-CONTROL MICRO with the B-CLOUD. They establish a reliable Wi-Fi or mobile network connection, allowing secure remote access to the compressor system.
Intermediate pressure gauge
Analog pressure gauges are installed at appropriate points of the compressor system and allow for easy monitoring of operating pressures. They support diagnostics and simplify maintenance work on the system.
Pre-lubrication pump
After extended downtimes, the bearings are automatically pre-lubricated to ensure safe start-up. This process is managed by the B-CONTROL control system.
section: B 26 series · Water-Cooled Compressors / BAUER KOMPRESSOREN

results.title: VERTICUS (420 bar) · PREMIUM LINE | BAUER KOMPRESSOREN
results.content:
Document: VERTICUS (420 bar) · PREMIUM LINE | BAUER KOMPRESSOREN
of breathing air. It is ideal for applications with the highest demands on air quality, such as firefighting, maritime operations, and professional diving.
What
performance ranges does the VERTICUS (420 bar) cover?
The VERTICUS (420 bar) is designed for final pressures of up to 420 bar and can deliver up to 560 liters per minute, making it ideal for continuous filling operations in stationary applications.
How
maintenance-friendly is the VERTICUS (420 bar) ?
The VERTICUS (420 bar) is engineered for low-maintenance operation. Its sturdy build and easily accessible components make maintenance quick and easy.
Which
conditions is the VERTICUS (420 bar) built to handle?
The VERTICUS (420 bar) is particularly well suited for applications that require a stationary breathing air supply.
How is
the VERTICUS (420 bar) operated and monitored?
The VERTICUS (420 bar) is equipped with the B-CONTROL MICRO control system. This enables simple operation, continuous monitoring of all relevant operating parameters and connection to the B-CLOUD and the B-APP.
What
benefits does the B-CLOUD provide?
The B-CLOUD enables central digital monitoring of the high-pressure system. Operating data, statuses and messages are available in real time and support condition-based maintenance as well as high system availability, particularly in high-performance industrial applications.
Accessories
